sidebar.emptyTitle: You don't have any sessions yet
sidebar.emptyBody: Start a practice to create your first one.

not_authenticated.title: Sign in to continue
not_authenticated.body: You need to be authenticated to access Bob.

no_profile.title: Account without associated profile
no_profile.body: Your user does not have a profile configured. Contact your school administrator.

not_student.title: Bob is for students
not_student.body: This pronunciation practice tool is available to students only. If you think this is an error, contact your school administrator.

no_organization.title: No school assigned
no_organization.body: Your account is not linked to any school. Ask the administrator to associate you with your institution before using Bob.

bob_not_enabled.title: Bob is not available at your school
bob_not_enabled.body: Your school has not activated Bob yet. Talk to your institution's administrator to request access.

no_license.title: Your Bob license is not active
no_license.body: Your school manages Bob licenses individually and yours is not active right now. Talk to your school administrator to get access.
